metadata.title: Why Arm Stock Is on Pace for Record High on Nvidia’s Chip Announcement<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Why Arm Stock Hit A Record High on Nvidia’s Chip Announcement
Nvidia has roiled the semiconductor sector with the launch of a PC chip. But there is one big beneficiary—semiconductor-design company Arm Holdings.
